categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production and sales of various single-sided and double-sided bright high-performance electrolytic copper foil products. The company operates two major electrolytic copper foil production bases in Yunmeng and Anlu. According to application fields, products are classified into lithium-ion battery copper foil and standard copper foil, which are widely used in new energy vehicles, energy storage devices, consumer electronics, copper-clad laminates, and printed circuit boards.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses design and optimization capabilities for automated electrolytic copper foil production lines, including copper dissolution, precision purification, stable foil generation, reliable surface treatment, and flexible steady-state automatic control. The company has developed core technologies related to key processes in the industry, including self-developed additives, production equipment design and modification, and intelligent control systems. The company has 114 patents and 2 software copyrights, and conducts product-industry-university research cooperation with universities such as Central South University and Huazhong University of Science and Technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers include major power battery manufacturers, energy storage battery manufacturers, and consumer electronics manufacturers. The company's products are widely applied in new energy vehicles, energy storage equipment, consumer electronics, copper-clad laminates, and printed circuit boards. The top five customers account for 61.69% of annual sales, with the largest customer representing 42.32% of sales revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Yunmeng and Anlu, Hubei Province. Sales are distributed across multiple regions including East China (43.83% of revenue), South China (25.31%), Southwest China (17.83%), Central China (11.68%), Northwest China (0.91%), Northeast China (0.35%), and North China (0.08%). The company also has subsidiaries in Wuhan, Jiangsu, and Yunnan provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream segment of the supply chain, serving as a materials supplier. Electrolytic copper foil is a key raw material for downstream manufacturers of lithium-ion batteries, copper-clad laminates, and printed circuit boards. The company purchases copper materials as primary raw materials and sells finished copper foil products to battery manufacturers and PCB producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technology innovation and product research and development, with R&D investment reaching 134.57 million yuan in 2023 (3.94% of revenue). Strategic focus areas include: developing ultra-thin lithium-ion battery copper foil (4.5μm, 5μm, 6μm), high-strength and high-elongation products, composite copper foil technology, and materials for solid-state batteries. The company collaborates with universities on advanced materials research and aims to optimize production processes and reduce energy consumption.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of electrolytic copper foil. The pricing model follows a 'copper material price plus processing fee' approach, where the processing fee is determined through market-based negotiations with customers based on product specifications, application requirements, and market supply-demand conditions. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of the goods, typically upon receipt or usage of products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a well-known enterprise in the high-performance electronic copper foil industry. Key competitors include Norde New Materials (600110), Longtian Huaxin Group, Guangdong Jiayuan Technology (688388), Jiujiang Defu Technology (301511), and Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil Group (301217). The company has established stable cooperation relationships with numerous leading customers and maintains competitive advantages through continuous technology innovation and product quality optimization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of 3.415 billion yuan (up 17.96% year-over-year) and net profit attributable to shareholders of 53.1 million yuan (down 87.15% year-over-year). Total assets reached 5.463 billion yuan (up 17.16%), and shareholders' equity was 3.733 billion yuan (down 5.12%). The company's revenue has grown steadily, though profitability declined significantly in 2023 due to industry competition and margin compression. The company has demonstrated strong growth trajectory since its IPO in April 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, ultra-thin copper foil products with superior physical properties, including 6μm and below extreme-thin lithium-ion battery copper foil as mainstream products, and newly developed 4.5μm and 5μm products. The company differentiates through: (1) advanced production line design and optimization capabilities enabling flexible product switching; (2) comprehensive product specifications covering 10μm to 140μm standard copper foil; (3) strong technical capabilities in surface treatment and quality control; (4) established relationships with leading battery manufacturers; and (5) continuous innovation in high-strength, high-elongation products meeting evolving customer requirements.
